title: Bind a rounded width-one child to selected MOVE9896 (no κ)
body:
Implement one actual selected PR6030 native return: zero-based MOVE9896, public role236, frame3=[] to frame7=[21], tensor width one. The complete literal prefix proves its entrance is `initial236−2*initial720`, already on coarse grid h. This binds PR6509's existing rounded pair kernel to PR6499's exact scalar-record consumer, without another downcast. It is a new actual-consumer binding and in-place implementation, not a new generic rounding theorem or supplier admission.

The field has 512 complex coordinates. Source-authenticated normal compilation and an independent binary/phase oracle agree on all 512 ideal columns of Γ_[21]=K C K†. The implementation performs two in-place monomial maps around 256 literal kernel pairs. Per-pair squared error≤h² gives completed field error≤16h. With n=9,p=t+14,h=B2^-p, this is exactly 6499's native allowance. A valid public initial field attains 256h² through deterministic nonzero rounding. No free independent-error injections are used. Ideal basis-column equality is not extrapolated to a nonlinear rounded map; actual rounded data are checked separately.

The direct invoice includes 1024 Gaussian swaps,512 selected phase-component negations,2560 kernel data additions,512 exact half shifts,4096 kernel checks, all conversions/read-write traffic, fixed route/program preparation/storage and pair-local/control requests. One Gaussian swap temporary returns exactly zero; no extra whole field bank is retained. The guarded reference also charges1024 component squares, one cap square and1024 wide additions. Guard products use2p+21 unsigned bits and the sum2p+31; the native/swap path uses p+21 words and p+16 field records. The complete guarded bit-work upper bound is O(512*(p+21)^2), with a linear core transform. Counts are logical bounded-record dataflow, not CPython instruction counts or a physical gate/tape tariff.

Evidence: both implementations' normal/optimized emissions and strict receipts pass; the independent oracle matches all six complete 512-coordinate fixture inputs/outputs, exact error squares, in-place identity and zero swap words, plus all 512 ideal columns/source history. Actual wrong-phase, inverse-sign and omitted-frame-map controls produce squared errors 16384,8192,8192, exceeding 256. Misalignment, bad norm and omitted last swap are rejected. Eight external optimized corruption tests pass. Registered replay,19 committed-file bytes/modes and declared canonical-base provenance, official export integrity and four read-only Git-free/empty-PATH replays pass. The published head `2f02d6b9b460227d72df1ed1914bbc1091be01d7` has exactly the tested/exported tree `2cff483dba94701e7e5a0c236dec58d652308825`. Both hosted jobs passed at this exact head in [run41568037463](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41568037463): all711 helper tests and the registered package replay. Completed logs were read once; run metadata matches the head and the synthetic test tree equals the published/exported tree. No actual merge.

Reproduce using CPython 3.12 and the standard library: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-event9896-rounded-child`.

Scope limits: width one, one actual child, coarse-aligned entrance. The pair kernel's internal workspace initialization/clear requests retain their indexed model; a clean reversible bit/tape implementation is not proved by state-map invertibility or Python garbage collection. Physical routing, bit circuitry, all-width errors, other native sites, global stock/paid allowance, full caller/supplier/compiler/outer admission and all five framework assumptions remain open. No new kappa, accelerated tariff, selected-frontier change or runtime-speedup claim. Selected supplier replay, Lean and Docker were not run. The independent oracle checks mathematical results/core logical counts; full primary bit/guard billing is covered by source review and its trace, not a second complete bit meter.

Task `supplier-boundary-audit`, scope key `8245d989f16dd0cbc0d4`, changed/narrowed to this numerical producer-consumer boundary. [Claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19364477). Base/submission main `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority 8, selected PR6030 and all eight guidance pins unchanged. Six exact source objects are pinned:6499head `d8f450f1583c4f150b0ed2a8db177453d49c841d`,6509head `a4173e810c4d34a1d13b9745af123ad0ec6cfed5`, canonical word/compiler. Source6499/6509heads remain current at submission. The 473-open-PR cache, current1166claims and6509's released5475handoff, bounded all-state searches and fresh latest bodies distinguish related work; hidden/unpublished work and arbitrary historical diffs remain unknown.

Credit Ali Romman/6509 kernel and theorem,6499 records; JoyboyBrian/5485 and4743 port/error lineage; DreamingOfClouds/6030; Cinna Davis, David Arias, Gareth Davidson and retained native/compiler sources; Tekalign, Arham Tahir, Nick Petalas, Adam Gall and all copied notices. New binding/checks by ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate AI implementation/static review, Apache-2.0. No independent human or formal-kernel acceptance is claimed. Maintainer edits and auto-merge disabled; no merge requested.
